content.subject: Flexport fulfillment expansion and finance ops
content.draft_text:
Hi Ryan,

I'm Khadyot from Zamp. We connect finance and ops systems, match records across them, and surface exceptions for review.

Saw that Flexport launched fulfillment services in Canada and the United Kingdom. I imagine keeping the new fulfillment financial data aligned across operational systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We ingest the fulfillment transaction feeds, reconcile them against your accounting entries, and flag any mismatches, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something you're thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Khadyot
